Independent validation of the working-tree remediation for PR #956 (base HEAD b5ce36392435f391fe94f7a1a71bcd679fc08c36).

A. Invariants: custom providers must not inherit built-in delivery claims; capability failure must remain distinct from empty success; retry must recover without replacing drafts/selection/one-time keys; widget mount must share one capability query; PR metadata must match IMAP mode.

B. Execution paths: Serena traced WebBridge -> Bridge normalization -> Channels API; confidential Engine ManageWidgetConnector/WidgetConnectorSettings snapshot -> WebWidgetLive apply_snapshot -> shared modal; all three modal open/retry paths; widget initial async health refresh and later scheduled refresh. Initial health refresh reuses the snapshot; later refresh still obtains current settings. Shared component callers retain the default non-error contract. Read-only UI state is the final owner here; no new durable writes/post-commit observers.

C/D. Proven regressions or pre-existing defects: none found in the reviewed scope. Compared changes with pre-remediation HEAD; original code unconditionally merged delivery flags, collapsed failures to empty maps, and performed the duplicate widget mount query. No existing test assertion/scenario was changed.

I. Verdict: comment — no reproducible correctness blocker found in the local fixes, but do not treat this as completed merge validation while E2E/final gates remain outstanding.

Validation scope correction after user asked about Mattermost: Serena confirms ChannelsLive still converts failed capability lookups to %{}, open_capabilities only toggles visibility, and its template does not pass error?. Mattermost and other providers served by the generic retrieval route therefore retain the blank-modal/no-retry bug. DataSources.ProviderLive has the same fallback/open behavior and omitted error? input (other refresh operations may reload its snapshot). This predates the PR, but the remediation does not fix the invariant across all shared-modal consumers. Earlier validation applies only to SMTP, IMAP and Web Widget; broader capability-modal recovery remains incomplete. No production changes made.
